name: Stryker
description: Stryker is a medical technology company based in Kalamazoo, Michigan, USA. In surgical robotics, Stryker produces the [Mako](/robot/stryker_mako) orthopedic system (acquired via Mako Surgical in 2013). In October 2026, Stryker made a preferred equity investment in [CMR Surgical](/company/cmr_surgical)—including an option to acquire the company—and became the exclusive U.S. sales agent for the [Versius](/robot/cmr_versius) soft-tissue robotic system.
